name: Rulebook Essential
description: Level essential, the root. Lists the ids whose action differs from the analyzer default. Generated from docs/rulebook; do not edit.

rules.justification: A property Microsoft has obsoleted will be removed in a later version; an upgrade risk a healthy project fixes, Warning from Recommended.
The empty CONST() filter is deprecated syntax with the same meaning as CONST(" "); a cheap cleanup, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A permission set names an object that is not in the project or its dependencies, so it grants nothing; broken setup, Warning from Recommended.
Sorting on a field that no key covers forces SQL to sort without an index; a performance risk, Warning from Recommended.
A unique ID on an element where IDs are deprecated is dead syntax; harmless cleanup, advisory then a gate from Strict.
CaptionML style multilanguage text in an app that uses translation files bypasses the XLIFF round trip; translations go missing, Warning from Recommended.
Uses an object marked for removal whose replacement may not be released yet; advisory at Recommended, a gate from Strict.
A label property sits outside its designated attribute, so translators and the Locked flag may not see it; Warning from Recommended.
The compiler cannot write a generated translation or layout file because it is read only, so that output is stale; kept at the author's default.
A translation unit whose source no longer matches the label is ignored, so users see the untranslated text; Warning from Recommended.
A translated string longer than the label allows is trimmed, so users see cut text; Warning from Recommended.
Two translation units for the same ID make the translation ambiguous; a defect in the XLIFF file, Warning from Recommended.
An image name that is wrong or unsupported for the control is not shown to the user; a visible defect, Warning from Recommended.
An Image on a nested action group in the Sections area is ignored by the client; cosmetic, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A constant outside the ordinal range of the option type is a value no caption maps to; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
References a symbol that is already removed, where the compiler still tolerates it; it breaks once the schema goes, Warning from Recommended.
A codeunit local variable named like a field of its table shadows that field, so code reads the variable instead; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A codeunit global variable named like a field of its table makes it unclear which one code refers to; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A table field named like a system field shadows it, so code and filters hit the wrong one; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A subscriber declares Option where the publisher passes an enum, so the types drift apart; an upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
An enum conversion relies on AssignmentCompatibility and the compiler relays the enum author's reason; kept at the author's default.
An implicit conversion that can lose data or fail at runtime, such as enum to Option or Text to Code; Warning from Recommended.
Hidden twin of the implicit with future error that feeds the qualify code action; Hidden from Recommended, Info in Complete.
Hidden twin of the explicit with future error that feeds the code action removing with; Hidden from Recommended, Info in Complete.
A preprocessor directive lacks its identifier or number, so it does not do what the author meant; Warning from Recommended.
A pragma warning directive without disable or restore is ignored, so the suppression is not applied as intended; Warning from Recommended.
An unrecognized pragma is ignored, usually a typo that leaves warnings unsuppressed or code unchanged; Warning from Recommended.
An implicit with pragma without disable, enable or restore is ignored, so the with scope is not what the author meant; Warning from Recommended.
Trailing text after a preprocessor directive is not allowed and the directive may be misread; Warning from Recommended.
Badly formed XML in a doc comment drops that documentation from the generated output; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A parameter left out of an otherwise documented signature leaves the docs incomplete; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Every undocumented public member is reported once doc diagnostics are on, which is noisy for most apps; Info at Strict, a gate in Complete.
A doc comment on a spot the compiler ignores is lost documentation; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A param tag naming no actual parameter is stale documentation after a rename; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A paramref naming no actual parameter is a stale doc reference after a rename; advisory, a gate from Strict.
The same parameter documented twice leaves contradicting docs; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A doc comment cref that does not resolve is a broken documentation link; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Enum identifiers that share their leading characters beyond the limit can collide at runtime; Warning from Recommended.
A BigInteger narrowed implicitly in a property expression can overflow at runtime; Warning from Recommended.
A BigInteger narrowed implicitly to an enum in a property expression can overflow into a wrong enum value; Warning from Recommended.
Reports a metadata name clash with a member of another extension, often one the team does not own; compiler information, Info from Recommended.
An object that no entitlement covers is unreachable for cloud users of an app that sells through entitlements; Warning from Recommended.
Permissions on objects of another module inside an entitlement permission set are silently ignored; Warning from Recommended.
A FlowField without CalcFormula never gets a value, a likely bug in the table design; Warning from Recommended.
Joker or Variant passed where a Field is expected may or may not hold a field, so the compiler only informs; Info from Recommended.
A member with an empty name cannot be referenced or personalized reliably; Warning from Recommended.
A public method returning an internal type is unusable outside the module, an extensibility gap; Warning from Recommended.
A public method taking an internal parameter type cannot be called outside the module, an extensibility gap; Warning from Recommended.
Division by Abs of an integer changed behaviour in runtime 11 and can give a different result than intended; Warning from Recommended.
A file pattern matching over a thousand files slows the build without a code defect; describes the build, Info from Recommended.
Using directives in a file without a namespace are ignored, dead lines that mislead the reader; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A using directive repeated in the same namespace declaration is clutter; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Unused using directives feed the remove action of the editor; Hidden until Complete, where they show as Info.
Use of an object marked to move to another app; the new home may not ship yet, so advisory first, a gate from Strict.
An object named with a bare integer is easily confused with its ID; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An ErrorInfo or Notification action naming a method the codeunit lacks, or with the wrong signature, fails when clicked; Error everywhere.
A name defined by two extensions binds to one of them silently and can call the wrong object; Warning from Recommended.
A field pending a move to another app kept in an active key blocks or breaks that move; Warning from Recommended.

Compiler warning at author severity from Recommended
Spacing around binary operators is pure layout the formatter fixes; no behaviour changes, so a gate from Strict only.
A stray space after a unary operator is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.
Spacing after NOT is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.
BEGIN..END around a single statement is clutter, not a defect; style gated from Strict.
Parentheses on parameterless calls tell a call from a field or variable at a glance; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Placement of BEGIN after THEN, ELSE or DO is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.
Control keywords that do not start a line are layout only and the formatter fixes them; a gate from Strict only.
Ordering declarations by type is a house style with no effect on behaviour and many hits in old code; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Rewriting IF ELSE chains as CASE is a readability opinion; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Nested WITH makes it unclear which record a name binds to and can bind the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Granting permissions on another app's objects from a permission set extension breaks when that app changes and widens access silently; Warning from Recommended.
Pulling another app's permission sets into an extension couples to permissions you do not own and widens access; Warning from Recommended.
Including sets that carry permissions on another app's objects widens access through a set you do not control; Warning from Recommended.
A temporary record without the Temp prefix invites DeleteAll or Modify on what a reader thinks is real data; Warning from Recommended.
Approved label suffixes (Msg, Err, Qst, Tok, Lbl) show how a text is used; naming advice, a gate from Strict.
The lower-permissions test library declared outside a test codeunit drags test tooling into production code; Warning from Recommended.
Quoted identifiers make code harder to read and search; naming advice, a gate from Strict.
API page property values are a public contract that cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
API page field names are the JSON contract and cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
API query property values are a public contract that cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
API query column names are the JSON contract and cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
Arguments that do not match the placeholders leave raw %1 text or drop values in user messages; Warning from Recommended.
Unreachable code usually means a misplaced exit or condition, a likely bug; Warning from Recommended.
An unused variable is dead weight that hides typos; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Assigning longer text to a shorter target overflows at runtime once the value is long enough; Warning from Recommended.
A var parameter that is never written misleads callers about side effects; advisory, a gate from Strict.
AssertError belongs to the test runner; outside a test codeunit it signals test logic in production code; Warning from Recommended.
Finding a record whose values are never used costs a database round trip for nothing; performance, Warning from Recommended.
FindSet or Find without Next fetches a result set that is never iterated; performance, Warning from Recommended.
An invalid ApplicationArea value hides the control from users; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
An action with no trigger and no run object shows a button that does nothing; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A local that shadows a global makes it easy to read or write the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.
The order of ApplicationArea values has no effect; consistency only, Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Values listed next to All are redundant and suggest a misunderstanding of the setting; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Basic without Suite can hide the control in experiences that enable Suite only; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A local named like a field, method or action shadows it and code silently uses the local; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A method named like a field or action makes calls and field access ambiguous to readers; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A global named like a field, method or action shadows it across the object; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Reading a variable before any assignment relies on a default value and often hides a missing initialisation; Warning from Recommended.
A value assigned and never read is a dead store that can hide a lost result; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A non-local event subscriber becomes callable API surface that cannot be changed later; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.
Filtering on fields without a supporting key scans tables; a performance hint with false positives, advisory, a gate from Strict.
CalcFields on a field that is neither a FlowField nor a Blob throws a runtime error when it runs; Error everywhere.
An obsolete marking without state or reason either does not obsolete at all or leaves consumers no guidance; Warning from Recommended.
Modify on a record that was not changed costs a write for nothing or reveals a missing assignment; Warning from Recommended.
File naming conventions help navigation but renaming old files is churn; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Concatenated user messages cannot be translated as a whole; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
A literal format string in StrSubstNo cannot be translated; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
Page fields and actions without a tooltip leave users without in-product help; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An empty tooltip shows users a blank help bubble; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
Option controls without OptionCaption show untranslated raw option names; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
SIFT on a primary or unique key maintains totals over single rows, a write cost with no benefit; performance, Warning from Recommended.
An empty OptionCaption shows users blank option values; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A caption count that differs from the options shows users wrong or missing values; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
Page fields without a caption fall back to the source name and may not translate; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
An empty caption shows users a field without a label; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
An unused local method is dead code to maintain; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Pinning a version on a platform assembly breaks the reference when the platform updates; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
StrSubstNo or concatenation inside Error hides the label from telemetry and translation; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A FlowField without a supporting SIFT key computes by scanning; a performance hint, advisory, a gate from Strict.
Next after Get, FindFirst or FindLast loops on a single-row fetch and reads row by row; performance and likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Per-company install code without a company-initialise subscriber leaves companies created later unconfigured; a real defect, raised to Warning from Recommended.
A real record named Temp invites DeleteAll on what a reader thinks is a buffer, risking data loss; Warning from Recommended.
E-mail addresses and phone numbers in source leak personal data into the repository and the app; Warning from Recommended given test-data false positives.
Lowercase keywords are style; Hidden keeps the code action available, visible from Strict.
Reading a field not in SetLoadFields triggers an extra JIT load per record; performance, Warning from Recommended.
Running a codeunit of subtype Upgrade throws a runtime error; Error everywhere.
A parameter named like a global shadows it so the body may use the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A parameter named like a field, method or action shadows it within the method; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A pragma that disables every diagnostic hides real errors and future warnings; Warning from Recommended.
Namespaces avoid name clashes and are the platform direction; advisory while code migrates, a gate from Strict.
The this qualifier is a readability preference; Hidden keeps the code action available, visible from Strict.
A page field trigger that a property disables never runs, so its logic is silently skipped; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
An obsoleted external business event without the marker keeps Power Automate users unaware of its removal; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
An event marked obsolete in its name but not by attribute is inconsistent metadata, not a runtime failure; Warning from Recommended, kept below the Error default.
Moving a table that carries external business events moves the events and breaks subscribed external flows; an upgrade break, not a runtime failure, Warning from Recommended.
FieldName and TableName show untranslated names where FieldCaption and TableCaption translate; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
A CalcDate formula string without angle brackets is parsed in the user's language and gives wrong dates elsewhere; Warning from Recommended.
Placeholders without a comment leave translators guessing what is substituted; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
An AI test suite file that fails schema validation cannot be loaded by the test tool; a definite test failure, Error from Recommended as only tests are hit.
Unordered using directives are cosmetic and the code action sorts them; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
An action without an image shows a generic icon in the action bar; a polish point, advisory, a gate from Strict.
A page or report without UsageCategory and ApplicationArea cannot be found through search; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A Blob of subtype Bitmap on a page is a deprecated pattern that Media or MediaSet replaces; an upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
A repeater placed after other content on a List page breaks the expected list layout; a healthy project fixes it, Warning from Recommended.
Promoted actions without PromotedOnly appear twice in the command bar; a clutter issue, advisory, a gate from Strict.
Actionrefs that target actions in a hidden group still render today but may be hidden later; an upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
Using InternalsVisibleTo is legitimate for test apps; the reminder that it is no security boundary is advice, Info until Complete.
Permissions defined in XML files are a legacy format the PermissionSet object replaces; an upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
A permission set extension that grants access to another app's objects can give users more than intended; Warning from Recommended.
A permission set extension that pulls in another app's permission set can give users more than intended; Warning from Recommended.
Including a set that carries another app's permissions through an extension widens access beyond intent; Warning from Recommended.
An explicit Base Application dependency instead of the application property ties the app to one variant; Warning from Recommended.
An enum ordinal outside the app's range can collide with another extension's values; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An object name that a dependency already uses causes runtime and compile problems for apps without namespaces; Warning from Recommended.
A table field without an explicit AllowInCustomizations value is advice that feeds a code action; Hidden, visible from Strict.
A configured baseline that cannot be loaded silences every breaking-change check; broken setup, Error from Recommended.
Object or member without the mandatory affix fails AppSource submission; needs mandatoryAffixes, so off at Essential and Error from Recommended.
AppSource requires the TranslationFile feature; a marketplace check, off at Essential and Error from Recommended.
An unsupported page property change can break dependent page extensions but not data or the upgrade; Warning from Recommended.
Removing a page property that dependents rely on can break page extensions, not data or the upgrade; Warning from Recommended.
AppSource requires EULA, privacy statement, help and similar manifest fields; marketplace check, off at Essential, Error from Recommended.
AppSource requires a valid url in the manifest; a marketplace check, off at Essential and Error from Recommended.
AppSource requires the affixes declared in AppSourceCop.json; fires in every unconfigured project, so off at Essential, Error from Recommended.
Reports that no supportedCountries list is configured; a marketplace hint, off at Essential and visible from Strict.
A supportedCountries entry that is not an ISO 3166-1 code is broken marketplace configuration; Warning from Recommended.
Missing translations for a targeted locale; needs supportedCountries and XLIFF files, off at Essential and visible from Strict.
An obsolete tag that is not the next release version breaks the tag policy; needs obsoleteTag settings, visible from Strict.
An Obsolete attribute without a tag hides when the member goes away; needs obsoleteTag settings, visible from Strict.
An obsolete tag that differs between branches confuses the removal schedule; needs a baseline and tag policy, visible from Strict.
An Obsolete attribute without a reason is good practice that the AppSource validation ruleset hides; Hidden from Recommended.
An obsolete tag that does not match the configured pattern; needs obsoleteTag settings, visible from Strict.
An unaffixed procedure in an extension object can clash with a later base or partner procedure; needs mandatoryAffixes, so off at Essential and Warning from Recommended.
Using InternalsVisibleTo is legitimate for test apps; the reminder that it is no security boundary is advice, Info until Complete.
Object ids outside the AppSource range assigned to the app block submission; marketplace only, so off at Essential and Error from Recommended.
An explicit Base or System Application dependency instead of the application property pins versions and complicates upgrades; Warning from Recommended.
A longer published field can overflow when dependents copy it into their shorter fields; an upgrade risk to review, Warning from Recommended.
A comma in a translated enum caption splits it into extra option captions so users see shifted labels; Warning from Recommended.
Deleting a published id-less object can break dependents, but AL offers no way to obsolete these objects; Warning everywhere as in the Microsoft validation ruleset.
Missing dependencies of the baseline make the breaking-change checks impossible; needs a configured baseline, so off at Essential and Error from Recommended.
An app without an Application Insights resource gives the publisher no telemetry; a marketplace expectation, off at Essential and Warning from Recommended.
Permissions defined in XML files are a legacy format the PermissionSet object replaces; an upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
A new object or member without the mandatory affix can clash with other apps; needs mandatoryAffixes and a baseline, so off at Essential and Warning from Recommended.
Advice on member ids outside the allowed range, which enum values bound to Dataverse trip legitimately; Info in Complete only.
A table that no permission set covers fails with a permission error for every user without SUPER; Error everywhere.
Turning a normal table temporary makes sync fail while it still holds data, which upgrade code must clear first; a risk to review, Warning from Recommended.
A permission set extension that grants access to another app's objects can give users more than intended; Warning from Recommended.
A permission set extension that pulls in another app's permission set can give users more than intended; Warning from Recommended.
Including a set that carries another app's permissions through an extension widens access beyond intent; Warning from Recommended.
The app a symbol moved from is missing from the baseline, so the move cannot be validated; a setup gap to fix, Warning from Recommended.
The moved symbol is not in the named source package, so the move cannot be validated; a setup gap to fix, Warning from Recommended.
A changed XLIFF translation id drops the existing translations of that element; advisory, a gate from Strict.
InternalsVisibleTo naming another publisher exposes internals to an app the publisher does not control; Warning from Recommended.
Objects outside a two-level namespace are an organization and naming concern, noisy on legacy code; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An object name that a dependency already uses causes runtime and compile problems for apps without namespaces; Warning from Recommended.
Reports tables added under the configured additive-change folder, a hotfix policy Microsoft leaves hidden; kept at the author's default, visible from Strict.
Reports fields added under the configured additive-change folder, a hotfix policy Microsoft leaves hidden; kept at the author's default, visible from Strict.
Reports keys added under the configured additive-change folder, a hotfix policy Microsoft leaves hidden; kept at the author's default, visible from Strict.
Changing the version of a published external business event can break the flows that consume it; Warning from Recommended.
Changing a field id without obsoleting the old field risks losing its data on upgrade; Warning from Recommended.
A table field without an explicit AllowInCustomizations value is advice that feeds a code action; Hidden, visible from Strict.
A new field without AllowInCustomizations leaves its exposure to user customization undecided; Warning from Recommended.
A field widened from Integer to BigInteger can overflow dependents that read it into Integer; Warning from Recommended.
A parameter widened from Integer to BigInteger can break dependents that call or subscribe with Integer; Warning from Recommended.
Adding or removing a required interface method can fail dependent implementers at runtime; Warning from Recommended.
A fully namespaced object outside the compliant namespace fails the AppSource affix requirement; marketplace only, off at Essential and Error from Recommended.
Affix settings are ignored once FullNamespaceScope is on, a confusing configuration; marketplace only, Info from Recommended and a gate from Strict.
Removing a codeunit used as a default interface implementation can fail dependents at runtime; Warning from Recommended.
A subscriber without var gets a copy, so its changes never reach the publisher; often harmless for a read only subscriber, Warning from Recommended.
Clear or ClearAll leaves a SingleInstance codeunit's state intact, so an intended reset silently does nothing; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A record that does not match the page's source table fails with a conversion error when the page or lookup runs; Error everywhere.
TransferFields between fields of one id with incompatible types throws at runtime, also in base app posting; Error everywhere.
Same field id under different names across a TransferFields pair copies values into the wrong field; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Text that may exceed the target length through Validate, SetFilter, Get or a translated label throws at runtime; Warning from Recommended like AA0139.
A subscriber that can lower the handled flag undoes an earlier subscriber's decision; an extensibility bug, Warning from Recommended.
ApplicationArea on an API page is ignored and only adds noise; cleanup advice, a gate from Strict.
A business key in ODataKeyFields breaks Power Automate and stored links, and changing it after release breaks consumers; Warning from Essential.
An API page without id and lastModifiedDateTime lacks a stable identifier and silently loses webhooks; Warning from Recommended.
Running table triggers on a temporary record can write to the database through trigger code; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A field shorter than the field it relates to truncates looked up values and fails validation; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Random GUIDs in key fields fragment the SQL index and slow inserts; performance advice, a gate from Strict.
Reads without SetLoadFields fetch every column; performance advice that fires on most reads, a gate from Strict.
Partial records before a full-record write force a JIT load that costs a roundtrip and can fail under concurrency; Warning from Recommended.
A placeholder without a matching argument shows a literal placeholder to the user; a user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended like AA0131.
CalcFields inside a loop issues one query per row and FlowField; a performance defect, Warning from Recommended.
SetRecord does not accept a temporary record and raises a runtime error; Error everywhere.
Direct field assignment skips OnValidate and its subscribers, but fires on most assignments and is often deliberate; advice from Strict, a gate in Complete.
A path that falls through returns an implicit default and can hide a logic bug; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A list page source table without lookup and drill-down pages leaves users no way to open the record from a field value; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A blank single-field key lets a later delete or rename cascade into every unrelated record with an empty relation field; data-loss risk, Warning from Recommended.
A direct Confirm call fails at runtime in job queues and web service calls where no UI exists; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Switching the session language by hand risks leaving it switched when the restore is missed or an error interrupts; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Hardcoding the page for document and setup tables opens the wrong variant, for example a quote on the order page; Warning from Recommended.
A public install or upgrade codeunit invites other apps to call it, so later cleanup becomes a breaking change; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
A permission set caption without a length cap lets translations exceed 30 characters and get truncated in the list; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Objects outside every permission set force administrators to grant access by hand before users can work; Warning from Recommended.
Without a caption a user-facing element gets no translation unit and shows the AL identifier in every language; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An integration event in an internal codeunit cannot be subscribed to from other apps, so the extension point is dead; Warning from Recommended.
Tooltip text without closing punctuation is a style lapse against the user assistance guidelines; too cosmetic to advise, a gate from Strict.
Field tooltips that do not open with Specifies break the wording convention of the standard application; style, a gate from Strict.
A line break escape in a tooltip renders as a literal backslash in the client; visible defect, Warning from Recommended.
Tooltips over 200 characters turn a quick hint into a block of text users must read; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An unlocked empty caption adds a blank translation unit that translators must skip in every language; translation hygiene, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A meaningful value at ordinal zero cannot be told apart from the default every new record gets; design advice, a gate from Strict.
A token label left translatable can be translated and break the API key or identifier it carries; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A caption on the empty enum value is dead metadata the platform ignores; harmless clutter, advisory then a gate from Strict.
An enum value with an empty caption cannot be picked in dropdowns; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A public event publisher freezes its signature as public API while subscribers need no public access; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.
Assigning the magic number 10 for a line feed hides intent that the Type Helper separators state; readability, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A field kept off every page can still be added and edited through page customization unless its exposure is set; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A locked label whose text equals its name is a token and should say so with its suffix; naming refinement, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A tooltip kept on the page instead of the table field must be copied to every page and goes stale; maintainability, a gate from Strict.
A page tooltip that repeats the table field tooltip stops following later table edits; maintainability, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A discarded Get or Find result raises only the generic platform error, often deliberately; noisy advice, Info from Strict.
Table access without declared object permissions fails for users who hold only indirect permissions; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Declared permissions the code never uses mislead anyone auditing what the object touches; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Advice that the app ships its own Rest Client handler so its own HTTP setting governs its calls; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.
Advice that the app carries its own Telemetry Logger instead of relying on another app of the publisher; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.
A numeric object id compiles silently when the object is renumbered or renamed, hiding drift a name would catch; Warning from Recommended.
A low maintainability score marks code that is costly to change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Too many execution paths make a procedure hard to test and change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A field repeating the table data classification keeps the old value when the table changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A control repeating the page application area keeps the old value when the page changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.
